Title: Euchologion To Mega: tes kata Anatolas Orthodoxou Katholikes Ekklesias periechon tas ton hepta mysterion akolouthias (the Great Euchologion of the Orthodox Catholic Church of the East, containing the services of the seven mysteries), catalogue title; the title page continues with the orders of ordination and other services
Creator: Orthodox Eastern Church (liturgical book), second edition, edited and supervised by Spyridon Zerbos, hieromonk, archimandrite of the Ecumenical Throne
Publisher: Venice: from the Greek printing house of Phoenix (ek tes Hellenikes Typographias tou Phoinikos), 1862 (title page)
Publication Date: 1862
Rights: Public Domain (pre-1930 publication); the host record carries no possible-copyright-status field
Language: grc (Greek; the OCR opens with a Google Books notice in Russian, misread as garbled Greek and Cyrillic-like capitals)
Source: Internet Archive item euchologion-to-mega, full-text OCR file Euchologion_To_Mega_djvu.txt, fetched directly by the library/source-research thread, 2026-09-29. The item page carries no possible-copyright-status or licence field. A Google Books boilerplate page (Russian, badly misread) heads the OCR.
Provenance note: Header prepended by the library thread; the OCR text follows unchanged, apart from this header. Rights basis: the title page, read from the OCR, gives Venice, 1862, more than 95 years before 2026; the host gives no rights field, so the printed date is the whole rights basis. OCR artifacts are left as found; nothing was corrected, re-spaced or retyped.
Content note: The Great Euchologion as printed in Venice. By its own title page it contains the services of the seven mysteries, the orders of ordination, other services, and the Apostle and Gospel readings of the chief feasts, and it refers to the Bucharest edition for part of its text. Second witness quality: the accented Greek is partly garbled; use it to cross-check a rite's wording, not as a clean quotable text.

γος, πρὸς γυναῖκα χήραν. Καὶ πολλοὶ λεπροὶ ἦσαν ἐπὶ

ἐκαθαρίσθη, εἰμὴ Νεεμαν ὁ Σύρος. Καὶ ἐπλήσθησαν πάν- 
τες Ουμοῦ ἐν τῇ Συναγωγῇ, ἀκούοντες ταῦτα. Καὶ ἀνα- 
στάντες, ἐξέδαλον αὐτὸν ἔξω τῆς πόλεως᾽ καὶ ἤγαγον αὐ- 
τὸν ἕως τῆς ὀφρύος τοῦ ὄρους, ἐφ᾽ οὗ ἡ πόλις αὐτῶν ᾧχο- 
δόμητο, εἰς τὸ κατακρημνίσαι αὐτόν. Αὐτὸς δὲ διελθὼν 
δια μέσου αὐτῶν, ἐπορεύετο.
